verdict.rationale: Mailgun is API-first: sending, receiving, tracking, domain/route management, and analytics are all exposed via documented APIs and SDKs, and an official MCP server lets AI agents perform most account actions conversationally. However, some account-level/UI-only functions (e.g., Control Panel-only spam filtering toggle, SAML SSO, dedicated IP pool configuration, DNS setup wizard) are referenced only as UI actions in docs, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (404s), making full UI-parity unverifiable. missing for 10: confirmed API parity for UI-only settings like spam filter toggle and SSO config, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation that MCP/API coverage is 1:1 with the web dashboard.
